title: Thank you!
body:
So glad I discovered this app a year ago. It really helped me out of burnout when I couldn’t get myself out of bed everyday. I’m still using this app to date to build micro habits :) Love the animations and whimsy of seasonal events. It’s just such a cute and thoughtfully-designed app. 

That being said, I wish the ‘Add task’ button was more quickly accessible though. Currently we have to scroll down to the end of the list to get to it and it’s not as convenient if the list is long. Would also love to have an overview of done/not done per task to help observe patterns in certain habits. 

Thank you for building this with love and care! :)

author: Lime Ink Story

title: disappointing
body:
I’ve been playing this game every single day for months, investing a huge amount of time and effort into collecting items and building my progress. Then suddenly, the game crashed—and when I reopened it, everything was gone. All my hard work and progress were completely wiped out, as if it never existed.

It’s extremely frustrating and heartbreaking to lose months of effort due to an issue that wasn’t even my fault. I’ve supported this game for a long time because I genuinely enjoyed it, but being forced to start over from scratch like this is incredibly discouraging.

On top of that, the app automatically subscribed me to a yearly plan without my permission, which only adds to the disappointment.

Please fix this issue and find a way to restore players’ data. Loyal players shouldn’t have to lose everything so unfairly :(

title: Restart after playing for so many months daily
body:
I’ve been playing this game every single day for months, putting in so much time and effort to collect items and build my progress. Then out of nowhere, the game crashes — and when I reopen it, everything is gone. All my hard work, all my progress, completely wiped out like it never existed.

I honestly can’t describe how frustrating and disappointing this feels. I’ve supported this game for so long because I genuinely enjoyed it, but now I’m forced to start all over again for something that wasn’t even my fault. It’s just heartbreaking to see months of effort disappear in an instant.

Please fix this issue and find a way to restore players’ data. It’s really unfair to lose everything like this after being such a loyal player.

title: might change ltr
body: i love the app, but at the same time, i have my apps that i interact w daily, and sometimes i think im forcing this to be one of them. i don’t want to feel that way, because the app has undeniably helped me a lot. the default apps i open sometimes need to stay closed, like socials or dating apps or whatever, but then my next options r usually my hoyoverse gacha games… that said, i wanna share a genuine suggestion for the implementation of a gacha system for the more rare items u can acquire for your finch, and maybe even a trading system? I love that there are ways to connect with the community, user to user, outside the app… but what about from within it? not asking for much maybe like some feed or forum of people using the app in your area or country, showing people’s in-app accomplishments (similar to pokemon pocket tcg). ik it’s  a tad selfish but i’m just pointing a few things out that would make the app more enticing and appealing, purely from a personal standpoint.

title: An adorable & creative way to help people care for themselves!
body:
I honestly did not expect such an amazing app when I downloaded this, as I’ve downloaded some other self care apps in the past and they almost never work out for me. The amount of kind people in the community and the amount of representation in the clothing store to dress up our Finch is something that made me smile. I adore the cute animations our Finch makes, it brings me immense joy.

The app lets you set tasks for yourself, where upon completion, you can earn rewards, its something that really motivated me. You can also do reflections, breathing exercises and stretches for rewards. In just a single day with this app, Ive already start noticing changes. Thank you for this amazing app! <3333
